en.headline: Five passengers suffer minor injuries after airport apron shuttle brakes suddenly
en.dek: A shuttle bus carrying travellers from the apron to the passenger terminal at Hong Kong International Airport made an abrupt stop late on Wednesday evening.
body: Five passengers sustained minor injuries after a shuttle bus on the apron of Hong Kong International Airport braked suddenly on Wednesday evening, police and hospital staff confirmed.

The incident occurred at about 10pm when the bus, which ferries travellers between the apron and the main terminal building, stopped abruptly. Passengers lost their balance and fell. Emergency services attended the scene and took the five injured people to North Lantau Hospital for treatment. All were reported to have only minor injuries.
Airport operations were not significantly disrupted. Authorities are investigating the circumstances of the sudden stop.

zh.headline: 機場停機坪穿梭巴士疑急煞 五人輕傷送院
zh.dek: 香港國際機場一輛接載旅客由停機坪前往客運大樓的穿梭巴士周三晚上突然煞停，五名乘客受傷。
body: 香港國際機場停機坪一輛穿梭巴士周三晚上約十時突然煞停，五名乘客失平衡跌倒受傷，送往北大嶼山醫院治理。
警方及醫院方面證實，傷者均為輕傷。事發時巴士正接載旅客由停機坪前往客運大樓。緊急服務到場處理，機場運作未受重大影響。
有關方面正調查巴士突然煞停的原因。
